Hello David,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention and providing clear device reproduction details. We have logged this incident as a High Priority (P2) defect with our iOS Mobile Engineering Team.

While our engineers deploy a patch for build 109, you can immediately complete your team license renewal without disruption by logging into the NovaCloud Web Portal at https://app.novatech.io/checkout. We will notify you the moment the mobile update is live in the App Store.

Best regards,
NovaTech Technical Support
